title: Cosmic Eye Creature
description: A spherical black creature with a large central turquoise eye stands on four short legs against a dark cosmic background. It wears a black hat adorned with gold wings and long black eyelashes, with smaller eyes visible on its body and a glowing purple aura surrounding it.
prompt: A spherical black creature with a giant luminous turquoise iris and pupil for a face, standing on four short segmented legs. It has a black hat with golden wing decorations and long dramatic black eyelashes. Smaller detailed eyes are visible on its body. The creature is centered in a dark cosmic void with purple glowing aura and floating particles, highly detailed surreal fantasy style.
